97 __attribute__((always_inline, hot, flatten)) inline void
98 centered_derivative(const Derivate<K> &input, Derivate<K> &output, size_t axis, K dx) const {
99 using Simd = simd::SimdTraits<K, DefaultISA>;
100 using reg = typename Simd::reg;
101 const size_t simd_width = Simd::width;
102 const K inv_2dx = K(1) / (K(2) * dx);
103
104 if (axis == 1) {
105#pragma omp parallel for
106 for (size_t i = 0; i < input.rows; ++i) {
107 output(i, 0) = K(0);
108
109 size_t j = 1;
110 const size_t simd_end =
111 (input.cols > simd_width + 1) ? (input.cols - simd_width - 1) : 1;
112 for (; j < simd_end; j += simd_width) {
113 if (j + simd_width > input.cols - 1)
114 break;
115
116 const K *left_ptr = &input(i, j - 1);
117 const K *right_ptr = &input(i, j + 1);
118 K *out_ptr = &output(i, j);
119
120 reg left = Simd::loadu(left_ptr);
121 reg right = Simd::loadu(right_ptr);
122 reg diff = Simd::sub(right, left);
123 reg res = Simd::mul(diff, Simd::set1(inv_2dx));
124 Simd::storeu(out_ptr, res);
125 }
126
127 for (; j < input.cols - 1; ++j)
128 output(i, j) = (input(i, j + 1) - input(i, j - 1)) * inv_2dx;
129
130 output(i, input.cols - 1) = K(0);
131 }
132 }
133
134 else if (axis == 0) {
135#pragma omp parallel for
136 for (size_t i = 1; i < input.rows - 1; ++i)
137 for (size_t j = 0; j < input.cols; ++j)
138 output(i, j) = (input(i + 1, j) - input(i - 1, j)) * inv_2dx;
139
140 for (size_t j = 0; j < input.cols; ++j) {
141 output(0, j) = K(0);
142 output(input.rows - 1, j) = K(0);
143 }
144 }
145
146 else {
147 std::cerr << "[centered_derivative] Invalid axis: must be 0 or 1\n";
148 }
149 }
158 __attribute__((always_inline, hot, flatten)) inline void
159 centered_derivative_order4(const Derivate<K> &input, Derivate<K> &output, size_t axis, K dx) {
160 using Simd = simd::SimdTraits<K, DefaultISA>;
161 using reg = typename Simd::reg;
162 constexpr size_t W = Simd::width;
163
164 const K inv_12dx = K(1) / (K(12) * dx);
165 const reg inv = Simd::set1(inv_12dx);
166 const reg eight = Simd::set1(8.0f);
167
168 if (axis == 1) {
169#pragma omp parallel for
170 for (size_t i = 0; i < input.rows; ++i) {
171 output(i, 0) = K(0);
172 output(i, 1) = K(0);
173
174 size_t j = 2;
175 for (; j + W <= input.cols - 2; j += W) {
176 const K *ptr_m2 = &input(i, j - 2);
177 const K *ptr_m1 = &input(i, j - 1);
178 const K *ptr_p1 = &input(i, j + 1);
179 const K *ptr_p2 = &input(i, j + 2);
180
181 reg fm2 = Simd::loadu(ptr_m2);
182 reg fm1 = Simd::loadu(ptr_m1);
183 reg fp1 = Simd::loadu(ptr_p1);
184 reg fp2 = Simd::loadu(ptr_p2);
185
186 reg term1 = Simd::mul(fp1, eight);
187 reg term2 = Simd::mul(fp2, Simd::set1(1.0f));
188 reg term3 = Simd::mul(fm1, eight);
189
190 reg num = Simd::sub(Simd::add(fm2, term1), term2);
191 num = Simd::sub(num, term3);
192 reg res = Simd::mul(num, inv);
193
194 Simd::storeu(&output(i, j), res);
195 }
196
197 for (; j < input.cols - 2; ++j) {
198 output(i, j) = (input(i, j - 2) - 8 * input(i, j - 1) + 8 * input(i, j + 1) -
199 input(i, j + 2)) *
200 inv_12dx;
201 }
202
203 output(i, input.cols - 2) = K(0);
204 output(i, input.cols - 1) = K(0);
205 }
206 } else if (axis == 0) {
207#pragma omp parallel for
208 for (size_t j = 0; j < input.cols; ++j) {
209 output(0, j) = K(0);
210 output(1, j) = K(0);
211
212 size_t i = 2;
213 for (; i + W <= input.rows - 2; i += W) {
214 const K *ptr_m2 = &input(i - 2, j);
215 const K *ptr_m1 = &input(i - 1, j);
216 const K *ptr_p1 = &input(i + 1, j);
217 const K *ptr_p2 = &input(i + 2, j);
218
219 reg fm2 = Simd::loadu(ptr_m2);
220 reg fm1 = Simd::loadu(ptr_m1);
221 reg fp1 = Simd::loadu(ptr_p1);
222 reg fp2 = Simd::loadu(ptr_p2);
223
224 reg term1 = Simd::mul(fp1, eight);
225 reg term2 = Simd::mul(fp2, Simd::set1(1.0f));
226 reg term3 = Simd::mul(fm1, eight);
227
228 reg num = Simd::sub(Simd::add(fm2, term1), term2);
229 num = Simd::sub(num, term3);
230 reg res = Simd::mul(num, inv);
231
232 Simd::storeu(&output(i, j), res);
233 }
234
235 for (; i < input.rows - 2; ++i) {
236 output(i, j) = (input(i - 2, j) - 8 * input(i - 1, j) + 8 * input(i + 1, j) -
237 input(i + 2, j)) *
238 inv_12dx;
239 }
240
241 output(input.rows - 2, j) = K(0);
242 output(input.rows - 1, j) = K(0);
243 }
244 } else {
245 std::cerr << "[SIMD Order4] Invalid axis: must be 0 or 1\n";
246 }
247 }
248};

256template <typename K, size_t Rank> class DerivateND {
257 public:
258 std::array<size_t, Rank> shape;
259 aligned_vector<K> data;
260 size_t block_size;
266 DerivateND(const std::array<size_t, Rank> &dims)
267 : shape(dims),

271 std::cout << "Auto-selected BLOCK_SIZE = " << block_size << std::endl;
272 }

274 inline size_t flatten_index(const std::array<size_t, Rank> &indices) const {
275 size_t index = 0, stride = 1;
276 for (int i = Rank - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
277 index += indices[i] * stride;
278 stride *= shape[i];
279 }
280 return index;
281 }
282
288 inline K &operator()(const std::array<size_t, Rank> &indices) {
289 return data[flatten_index(indices)];
290 }

297 inline const K &operator()(const std::array<size_t, Rank> &indices) const {
298 return data[flatten_index(indices)];
299 }

314 __attribute__((always_inline, hot, flatten)) inline void
315 centered_derivative(const DerivateND<K, Rank> &input, DerivateND<K, Rank> &output, size_t axis,
316 K dx) const {
317 using Simd = simd::SimdTraits<K, DefaultISA>;
318 using reg = typename Simd::reg;
319 const size_t simd_width = Simd::width;
320
321 const auto &shape = input.shape;
322 const size_t total = input.size();
323 const K inv_2dx = K(1) / (K(2) * dx);
324 const reg inv2dx = Simd::set1(inv_2dx);
325
326 std::array<size_t, Rank> strides;
327 strides[Rank - 1] = 1;
328 for (int i = Rank - 2; i >= 0; --i)
329 strides[i] = strides[i + 1] * shape[i + 1];
330
331 const size_t stride_axis = strides[axis];
332 const size_t dim_axis = shape[axis];
333
334#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
335 for (size_t flat = 0; flat < total; flat += simd_width) {
336 bool safe = true;
337
338 for (size_t offset = 0; offset < simd_width; ++offset) {
339 if (flat + offset >= total) {
340 safe = false;
341 break;
342 }
343
344 const size_t coord_axis = ((flat + offset) / stride_axis) % dim_axis;
345 if (coord_axis == 0 || coord_axis >= dim_axis - 1) {
346 safe = false;
347 break;
348 }
349 }
350
351 if (!safe) {
352 for (size_t offset = 0; offset < simd_width && flat + offset < total; ++offset) {
353 const size_t f = flat + offset;
354 const size_t coord_axis = (f / stride_axis) % dim_axis;
355
356 if (coord_axis == 0 || coord_axis >= dim_axis - 1) {
357 output.data[f] = K(0);
358 continue;
359 }
360 output.data[f] =
361 (input.data[f + stride_axis] - input.data[f - stride_axis]) * inv_2dx;
362 }
363 continue;
364 }
365
366 const K *ptr_fwd = input.data.data() + flat + stride_axis;
367 const K *ptr_back = input.data.data() + flat - stride_axis;
368 K *out_ptr = output.data.data() + flat;
369
370 reg forward = Simd::loadu(ptr_fwd);
371 reg backward = Simd::loadu(ptr_back);
372 reg diff = Simd::sub(forward, backward);
373 reg result = Simd::mul(diff, inv2dx);
374 Simd::storeu(out_ptr, result);
375 }
376 }
385 __attribute__((always_inline, hot, flatten)) inline void
386 centered_derivative_order4_rank(const DerivateND<K, Rank> &input, DerivateND<K, Rank> &output,
387 size_t axis, K dx) const {
388 using Simd = simd::SimdTraits<K, DefaultISA>;
389 using reg = typename Simd::reg;
390 constexpr size_t W = Simd::width;
391
392 const auto &shape = input.shape;
393 const size_t total = input.size();
394 const K inv_12dx = K(1) / (K(12) * dx);
395 const reg inv = Simd::set1(inv_12dx);
396
397 std::array<size_t, Rank> strides;
398 strides[Rank - 1] = 1;
399 for (int i = Rank - 2; i >= 0; --i)
400 strides[i] = strides[i + 1] * shape[i + 1];
401
402 const size_t stride_axis = strides[axis];
403 const size_t dim_axis = shape[axis];
404
405#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
406 for (size_t flat = 0; flat < total; flat += W) {
407 bool safe = true;
408
409 for (size_t offset = 0; offset < W; ++offset) {
410 if (flat + offset >= total) {
411 safe = false;
412 break;
413 }
414
415 const size_t coord_axis = ((flat + offset) / stride_axis) % dim_axis;
416 if (coord_axis < 2 || coord_axis >= dim_axis - 2) {
417 safe = false;
418 break;
419 }
420 }
421
422 if (!safe) {
423 for (size_t offset = 0; offset < W && flat + offset < total; ++offset) {
424 size_t f = flat + offset;
425 size_t coord_axis = (f / stride_axis) % dim_axis;
426 if (coord_axis < 2 || coord_axis >= dim_axis - 2) {
427 output.data[f] = K(0);
428 continue;
429 }
430
431 K fm2 = input.data[f - 2 * stride_axis];
432 K fm1 = input.data[f - stride_axis];
433 K fp1 = input.data[f + stride_axis];
434 K fp2 = input.data[f + 2 * stride_axis];
435
436 output.data[f] = (-fp2 + 8 * fp1 - 8 * fm1 + fm2) * inv_12dx;
437 }
438 continue;
439 }
440
441 const K *ptr_m2 = input.data.data() + flat - 2 * stride_axis;
442 const K *ptr_m1 = input.data.data() + flat - stride_axis;
443 const K *ptr_p1 = input.data.data() + flat + stride_axis;
444 const K *ptr_p2 = input.data.data() + flat + 2 * stride_axis;
445 K *out_ptr = output.data.data() + flat;
446
447 reg fm2 = Simd::loadu(ptr_m2);
448 reg fm1 = Simd::loadu(ptr_m1);
449 reg fp1 = Simd::loadu(ptr_p1);
450 reg fp2 = Simd::loadu(ptr_p2);
451
452 reg num = Simd::add(
453 fm2, Simd::sub(Simd::mul(fp1, Simd::set1(8)), Simd::mul(fp2, Simd::set1(1))));
454 num = Simd::sub(num, Simd::mul(fm1, Simd::set1(8)));
455 reg res = Simd::mul(num, inv);
456
457 Simd::storeu(out_ptr, res);
458 }
459 }
460};

472template <typename Container>
473inline Container richardson_derivative_container(const Container &plus_h, const Container &minus_h,
474 const Container &plus_half_h,
475 const Container &minus_half_h, double h) {
476 assert(plus_h.size() == minus_h.size());
477 assert(plus_h.size() == plus_half_h.size());
478 assert(plus_h.size() == minus_half_h.size());
479
480 Container out(plus_h);
481#pragma omp parallel for
482 for (size_t i = 0; i < plus_h.size(); ++i) {
483 auto diff_h = (plus_h[i] - minus_h[i]) / (2.0 * h);
484 auto diff_half = (plus_half_h[i] - minus_half_h[i]) / h;
485 out[i] = (4.0 * diff_half - diff_h) / 3.0;
486 }
487 return out;
488}

500template <typename T>
501inline T richardson_derivative(const T &plus_h, const T &minus_h, const T &plus_half_h,
502 const T &minus_half_h, double h) {
503 T diff_h = (plus_h - minus_h) / (2.0 * h);
504 T diff_half = (plus_half_h - minus_half_h) / h;
505 return (4.0 * diff_half - diff_h) / 3.0;
506}
